Accepts real USDT from a depositor who wants XON on Xode in return, and records which Xode address (`xodeBeneficiary`) should receive it - there is no cross-chain callback here, so a separate relayer service watches `Deposited` events on this contract and calls `XonVendingMachine.settleExternalPurchase` on Xode to actually pay out. `depositForSwap` is the market-price variant: it emits `SwapDeposited` with the depositor's minimum, and the relayer pays it with `settleExternalSwap` (a DEX swap on Xode) or refunds it. This contract is a custodial escrow, not a bridge: USDT deposited here sits in this contract's balance until the owner moves it - there is no on-chain mechanism connecting Ethereum and Xode (Xode has no live Snowbridge connection as of writing). What bounds a compromised owner (the custody rules in `Custodial`):  - `withdraw` only ever pays the `treasury` (meant to be a separate, cold multisig); changing the    treasury waits `TREASURY_DELAY`, during which the `guardian` can cancel it and pause.  - `refund` only pays a deposit back to the account that made it (or an address that account    named with `setRefundAddress`, e.g. if USDT has frozen it), once - deposits are recorded. On    Xode the deposit is cancelled first, so a refunded deposit can never also be paid out there.  - `refundFee` (raising it is a queued change) is only charged when the depositor's own minimum    couldn't be met, so a tight minimum isn't a free option on the price at the operator's cost.  - `minDeposit` keeps out dust deposits that would only ever turn into refunds.  - Ownership moves in two steps, so a wrong owner address can never take the gateway.","version":1}},"settings":{"compilationTarget":{"src/ethereum/EthUsdtGateway.sol":"EthUsdtGateway"},"evmVersion":"cancun","libraries":{},"metadata":{"bytecodeHash":"ipfs"},"optimizer":{"enabled":true,"runs":200},"remappings":[":forge-std/=lib/forge-std/src/"]},"sources":{"src/Custodial.sol":{"keccak256":"0x9560314adbcf1436bfc3c83fc02853f3a277f6946299c3592302fdd7702990e5","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://9ea765c7d09fd4ae308c3dd31740582c624237e654beb3f514b00b03bbf6b1ea","dweb:/ipfs/QmYspgW9ptxw8R5ywJsxCixFsNJNxeC2LzFKCMiKHJymTg"]},"src/ethereum/EthUsdtGateway.sol":{"keccak256":"0xc24f585f9a8fbea6b78bfba472092a7c673183233e07887cef784da30888dce3","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://73f0a2f3f36aa3469be65290364bbfa0ad873ab31fd2c3141f2b2f49e7799195","dweb:/ipfs/QmQJ5wggMwZT44zyCcfFpKHCp9zzDTprBSLQmLzsCTyenE"]},"src/interfaces/IERC20.sol":{"keccak256":"0x311bc8e76659b8003b582a1493843da9b42dde90dcf11e05cb91cb9ccbf3f208","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://f8dc24b42c9d5a029fbeeee8f5850cef9132beae135fba84e79961bb185cead4","dweb:/ipfs/QmPi2GVAVZqkgC1HFQJWavZ4TCSs6TMhEgU2xhnjsQeiFh"]}},"version":1}

cancelChange(bytes32).notice: The owner withdrawing a queued change, or the guardian stopping one.

cancelTreasuryChange().notice: The owner withdrawing its own proposal, or the guardian stopping one it didn't expect.

constructor.notice: `treasury_` is where withdrawals go (a cold multisig in production) and `guardian_` the key or multisig that can pause and veto treasury changes - both may start as `owner_` in development.

deposit(uint256,address).notice: Deposits `usdtAmount` USDT (requires a prior `usdt.approve(address(this), usdtAmount)`) and records `xodeBeneficiary` as who should receive the resulting XON on Xode. The relayer picks this up from the `Deposited` event and pays out for its `usdtAmount` - which is what actually arrived in this contract, not what was asked for, so a token that takes a fee on transfer (Ethereum USDT has a fee switch, currently off) can never be paid out above what the gateway really holds.

depositForSwap(uint256,address,uint256).notice: Like `deposit`, but asks to be paid at the Xode DEX's market price, receiving at least `minXonOut` XON (18-decimal units, as Solidity sees native XON on Xode) or a refund. Set it from a fresh quote minus your slippage tolerance. If USDT ever charges a transfer fee, the swap is for what arrived, so a tight minimum may then be refunded instead.

depositRecords(uint256).notice: keccak256(abi.encode(depositor, usdtAmount)) per deposit nonce, until it's refunded.

finishSetup().notice: Ends the setup phase: from now on the risky setters need `queueChange`. Irreversible.

guardianPause().notice: The guardian can stop the contract (not restart it - that's the owner's `setPaused(false)`).

minDeposit().notice: Smallest deposit accepted, in raw USDT units.

pendingOwner().notice: Nominated by `transferOwnership`; becomes owner once it calls `acceptOwnership`.

queueChange(bytes).notice: Queues `call` - the exact calldata of a later call to this contract - to be allowed after `CHANGE_DELAY`. Its id is `keccak256(call)`; watch `ChangeQueued` to see what's coming.

queuedChangeReadyAt(bytes32).notice: keccak256(calldata) of a queued call -> when it may run (0: not queued).

refund(uint256,address,uint256,bool).notice: Pays deposit `nonce` back, once - for a deposit that can't be paid out on Xode (cancel it there first with `XonVendingMachine.cancelExternalDeposit`). It goes to the depositor, or to the address the depositor named. `depositor` and `usdtAmount` must match the deposit's event; they're checked against the record. `chargeFee` keeps `refundFee` back - meant only for a deposit whose own minimum the pool couldn't meet, never for the operator's own failures.

refundAddress(uint256).notice: Where a deposit's refund goes instead of its depositor, if the depositor said so.

refundFee().notice: Kept from a refund when `refund` is told to charge it, in raw USDT units.

setRefundAddress(uint256,uint256,address.notice: The depositor of `nonce` (for `usdtAmount`, as in its event) names where a refund should go - for instance if USDT has frozen the depositing address. Only ever affects that deposit.

setRefundFee(uint256).notice: Lowering the fee is instant; raising it is a queued change (see `Custodial`).

setupFinished().notice: Until `finishSetup` (or the first `transferOwnership`), the deployer configures the contract freely; after it, the risky setters need a queued change.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Nominates `newOwner`, who becomes owner by calling `acceptOwnership`. `address(0)` cancels. Handing the contract over also ends its setup phase.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Moves custodied USDT to the treasury - the only place it can go besides a refund.
